slices.name: Acceptance truth repair
entryCriteria: Slice 1A staged candidate and audit receipt available
exitCriteria: clean index compiles independently
ignored contamination is rejected
index and commit hashes are reproducible
dependency edges are unique
review artifacts are repository-relative and hash-bound
legacy-authoritative workflow corpus is frozen before extraction and hash-bound
oracle capture occurs at the raw persisted result/event boundary; normalization and renderers are tested separately
rollback: remove only S1B verifier/spec artifacts; legacy runtime remains authoritative

slices.name: Durable modular host
entryCriteria: S1B green from a clean commit
exitCriteria: host creates immutable generations
journaled pointer promotion survives interruption
stale hosts refuse mismatched generations
safe mode loads kernel-only generation
versioned config/data migrations run only on staged copies and journal rollback restores the prior schema and bytes
Doctor, logs and receipts expose generation, journal recovery, blocked reasons and owner-attributed failures with secret redaction
rollback: select previous canonical generation without uninstalling packages

slices.name: Desired state, profiles, activation and grouped UI
exitCriteria: global desired state and profiles resolve deterministically
parent/child enablement rules enforced
disabled entries remain visible and unreachable
restart semantics explicit
grouped UI preserves keyboard operation, semantic labels and non-color-only blocked/disabled status
rollback: restore prior desired-state revision and generation pointer

slices.name: Physical shared-support extraction
entryCriteria: all support interfaces frozen and consumer inventory complete
exitCriteria: eleven support packages compile/pack independently
no private imports or duplicate kernel instances
legacy support adapters retain parity
public type baseline enforces semver and N-1/N-2 compile/load compatibility
resolver, registry, manifest and dependency graph gates survive targeted mutation testing
rollback: repoint compatibility adapters to legacy support implementations

slices.name: Physical first-party mod extraction
entryCriteria: support packages and grouped dependency rules green
exitCriteria: all 36 mod packages compile and pack
all 849 staged-subject legacy assignments have a destination
each mod can be disabled without surface reachability
dependent mods degrade or block as specified
each package migrates and verifies its config, state, static assets, history and persisted envelopes before legacy removal
rollback: enable legacy adapter per mod; never mix two owners for one contribution

slices.name: Generated surface cutover
entryCriteria: every first-party package has parity receipts
exitCriteria: CLI/TUI/MCP/Cesar/docs derive from one active registry generation
legacy handwritten dispatch is unreachable
all kill-list surface entries removed
generated TUI and documentation projections preserve accessibility metadata and readable fallback text

slices.name: Installer, updater, rollback and safe mode
entryCriteria: runtime cutover green in isolated prefixes
exitCriteria: install/update are journaled candidate-prefix transactions
crash and disk-full recovery proven
rollback and safe mode work offline
no active process self-overwrites
concurrent writers, ENOSPC, EACCES and torn-write recovery are proven
third-party activation remains fail-closed until S8 trust is green
rollback: atomic pointer restoration to retained qualified prefix

slices.name: Trust, grants and third-party folder mods
entryCriteria: transactional lifecycle and safe mode green
exitCriteria: static discovery executes no code
publisher trust and grants are explicit and revocable
edited content invalidates grants
load order and collisions deterministic
third-party failure cannot prevent safe mode
rollback: disable third-party source class and select first-party-only generation

slices.name: npm/npx distribution and release qualification
entryCriteria: all runtime, lifecycle and security slices green
exitCriteria: fresh macOS arm64/x64 and Linux arm64/x64 installs pass
npm pack contents and provenance pass
npx wizard is idempotent
upgrade/downgrade compatibility matrix passes
release checklist has no local red
historical persisted-state migration corpus passes upgrade and downgrade policy
native startup, memory, resolver, TUI, package-size, sustained-host and concurrent-workflow load budgets remain green
operational diagnostics and receipt schemas remain compatible across supported upgrades
license policy, SBOM, package provenance and integrity evidence match the release BOM
rollback: unpublish is not a rollback; promote a corrected version and retain last-known-good install
